home.title: <city>Istaravshan</city> School Portal
home.lead: The shared online system of the schools of Istaravshan, built on the scientific and technical progress of education in Tajikistan

school.title: The school, online
school.body: Every day-to-day task of the school runs online, in one system: marks, notices, attendance, every pupil's statistics and oversight of the teachers giving lessons, the timetable, school and class news and announcements. All of it is kept in the system without technical limits and fully accountable.

parents.title: Parents on Telegram
parents.body: Every parent and guardian receives regular messages on Telegram — one after another, tied to the lesson schedule, with everything current about their child at the set time.

chat.title: Chats and groups
chat.body: Chats and group chats with all pupils, teachers and other accounts — with files, location, voice messages and text.

support.title: Online support
support.body: Full online support for everyone who uses it: an answer within 20 minutes, and any system problem put right.

trust.title: Safe and fast
trust.body: The system gives you a full and worthy guarantee: to do your work safely, more easily, reliably and, above all, faster.

home.motto: The future of the nation's digital growth is in our hands

download.title: Get the app
download.subtitle: and use the portal more easily: notifications, quick launch, everything one tap away.

ios.name: iPhone and iPad
ios.hint: On the Home Screen · App Store

app.title: The МТМУ №7 app
app.lead: The same portal on your phone and computer: notifications for new messages, quick launch, and one tap to lessons and marks.

android.step2: If the phone asks, allow the browser to install unknown apps.
android.step3: Tap Install and open the app from your home screen.

ios.step1: Open the portal in Safari (on iPhone only Safari can install it).
ios.step2: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) and choose Add to Home Screen.
ios.step3: Tap Add: the МТМУ №7 icon appears on your Home Screen.

windows.step2: If Windows warns you, click More info → Run anyway.
windows.step3: The app appears on your desktop and in the Start menu.

app.note: The app uses the same account: sign in with the same login and password.
